description:
Add EmittingResolver decorator to packages/api-core/discovery/ that wraps the existing Resolver (not individual callsites). Transparent to scenarios — they continue calling discovery.ResolveScenarioURL/Port and events are emitted automatically.

**Event emission** — Fire-and-forget background goroutine (zero latency). Emit on: successful resolution ({scenario}.discovery.resolved.v1), timeout ({scenario}.discovery.timeout.v1), scenario-not-running ({scenario}.discovery.unavailable.v1). Pattern follows swarm-manager's eventlog Emitter (non-blocking, error-logged-but-not-propagated).

**Ring buffer for outage resilience** — Configurable max size (default: 1000 events or 10MB, whichever hit first). During outage: events enqueue. On reconnect: buffer flushes in order. Buffer full: oldest dropped with warning log.

**Sender-side policy cache** — Loaded at startup from vrooli-events, updated via SSE full-snapshot push (atomic replacement, no partial state). Implements: (1) token bucket rate limiting (capacity + refill_rate per rule, state as tokens_remaining + last_refill_time), (2) segment-count access control evaluation (exact=3, prefix glob=2, wildcard=1, summed across source+target+action, max 9, ties by earliest creation).

Graceful degradation: if vrooli-events is unreachable, last-known policy holds (configurable fail-open or fail-closed per rule). Must not break any existing inter-scenario communication.
name: discovery-event-emission-and-policy-cache
title: Integrate Event Emission And Policy Caching Into Discovery Package
